currentPhase.description: Learn-it Next P1 is integrated, post-merge verified and human-validated on Android. Issue #119 authorizes only one minimal bootstrap pull request that extends the accepted Remote Agent Worktree with fixed-profile read-only analysis and Learn-it Next validation profiles. Learning Loop V2 product implementation remains held until the bootstrap and one exact-baseline snapshot are accepted.

remoteAgentWorktree.policy: bounded patch, fixed profile, no write credentials during test, exact tested result committed only to the originating agent branch

codespaceEvidenceBridge.policy: fixed read-only evidence operations bound to an exact repository origin and target SHA

learnitNextCi.policy: build once, test exact bytes, publish the same HTML with proof

stageDOperatingModel.policy: disjoint developer, contradictory-QA, integrator and governor scopes for bounded work

branchHygiene.policy: main-only when no pull request is open

mainRuleset.name: main-protection
mainRuleset.reason: GitHub reports that the ruleset is not enforced on the current private personal-account repository.

authorizedWork: PROG-WP-001 bootstrap changes on one governed branch and one pull request from exact baseline d0a68fb4f47545a795934dc90ecadc834304c61e
fixed-profile read-only ANALYZE execution in the existing Remote Agent Worktree validation job
Learn-it Next fixed validation profiles and structured evidence artifacts
preservation of the accepted bounded IMPLEMENT exact-tested-result path
repository, workflow, tool, test, documentation and governor-state changes explicitly listed by PROG-WP-001
historical P1 maintenance only through separately authorized bounded work
heldWork: Learning Loop V2 product implementation until the PROG-WP-001 bootstrap is accepted and one exact-baseline snapshot is reviewed
creation of the four Learning Loop V2 development lanes until file ownership and shared interfaces are derived from the accepted snapshot
contract or storage semantic changes until an explicit program decision records their necessity and rollback
prohibitedWork: arbitrary shell commands, scripts, plugins or environment overrides supplied by an AI job
autonomous merge, release publication or direct write to main
passing GitHub write credentials to analyzed or patched repository code
creating a generic AI execution platform, scheduler, queue, database or orchestrator in PROG-WP-001
modifying Learn-it Next product source during the bootstrap
allowing an integrator to silently repair lane-owned product files
publishing an artifact different from the artifact tested
silently reusing or mutating protected RC718 storage

activeRisks.statement: The main-protection ruleset is configured but not enforced on this private personal-account repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: Move the repository to an eligible GitHub Team organization account or another topology that enforces private-repository rulesets.

activeRisks.statement: Adding analysis profiles to a write-capable workflow could accidentally route read-only jobs into the result-commit path.
activeRisks.closureGate: Unit and end-to-end tests prove every successful ANALYZE run skips all write-token jobs and leaves the branch unchanged.

activeRisks.statement: Learn-it Next sources and tests are partly manifest-controlled Git blobs rather than materialized files on main, so naive profiles can inspect or test an incomplete checkout.
activeRisks.closureGate: Every Learn-it Next profile materializes the complete declared tree and reports its inventory before validation.

activeRisks.statement: The browser vertical suite has previously required a bounded retry even though the final gate passed.
activeRisks.closureGate: Track profile attempts and remove deterministic causes before relying on a single-attempt promotion gate.

activeExceptions.rule: main branch protection must technically require pull requests and mandatory checks
activeExceptions.reason: The repository remains on the current private personal-account setup, where GitHub reports the configured ruleset as not enforced.
activeExceptions.expiryOrRemovalGate: repository plan or ownership topology change, serious governance bypass, or first external collaborator
activeExceptions.rollback: Remove this exception only after the repository reports the main-protection ruleset as enforced and a negative bypass test confirms the control.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Merge no bootstrap change until repository governance, PR scope, Remote Agent unit tests and independent review pass on the exact head. After merge, run one learnit-next-snapshot ANALYZE job against d0a68fb4f47545a795934dc90ecadc834304c61e, verify that the branch remains unchanged and review the structured artifact before authorizing Learning Loop V2 implementation lanes.

review.nextReviewTrigger: bootstrap PR exact head, scope drift, unsupported command surface, write-token reachability from ANALYZE, failed profile, incomplete materialization, product-source modification, requested contract or storage change, or proposed Learning Loop V2 lane activation
